visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person in a black T-shirt holds a large stainless steel bowl overflowing with golden-yellow fried sweet potato balls in a busy outdoor market setting. (2) A man at a food stall empties a blue plastic crate filled with more yellow balls into a tray for preparation. (3) A digital graphic appears on screen showing an Instagram post with rules for a 'Competitive Eating Challenge' at a Taichung shop. (4) The camera shows a close-up of the balls frying in oil, being stirred by a large paddle, followed by a hand holding a red envelope with 100-yuan bills. (5) A young man wearing glasses and a beige shirt sits at a table with a massive bowl of the snacks; a digital timer counts down. (6) He starts eating the snacks rapidly using bamboo skewers, looking determined as he stuffs several into his mouth at once. (7) He drinks from a paper cup and looks physically strained, holding his jaw while continuing to chew. (8) He uses his hands to squash the remaining balls in the bowl to make them easier to eat. (9) He shows the prize money again and then a quick montage of him eating other foods like fried chicken and burgers follows. (10) Screen recordings show a mobile app interface for Skyscanner, searching for hotels and flights in Taichung. (11) The man is seen in a hotel room and lobby, then eating beef and rice in another restaurant. (12) He eats the final sweet potato ball and the video ends with a shot of the food stall's storefront and its specific address.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced, upbeat electronic dance BGM starts immediately. A high-energy male voice shouts an exclamation with a sharp rising pitch. (2) Narrator speaks rapidly over the steady rhythm (~128 BPM). Faint outdoor market chatter provides a low background layer. (3) A swift 'whoosh' SFX signals a scene change. The narrator maintains a persuasive, excited tone while explaining the venue. (4) Distinct rustling and thudding sounds occur as dry food items hit a plastic tray. A bright 'ding' SFX highlights the challenge rules. (5) A sharp 'cha-ching' register SFX accompanies the mention of prize money. Vocal intensity remains consistently high and clear. (6) High-frequency sizzling sounds of hot oil are mixed into the track. The BGM remains locked in its rhythmic loop. (7) A digital 'beep-beep' countdown SFX begins. The narrator's speech rate further accelerates to match the onscreen tension. (8) Wet chewing and sharp crunching SFX are amplified. A brief liquid glugging sound occurs as a drink is consumed. (9) The narrator's vocal tone becomes slightly strained and rhythmic, mimicking physical exertion. A cartoonish 'boing' SFX adds humor. (10) Muffled thumping sounds correlate with objects being squashed in a metal bowl. A celebratory 'cha-ching' SFX sounds upon completion. (11) BGM maintains its energy. Crisp digital UI 'click' and 'pop' SFX appear during the smartphone app demonstration sequence. (12) Heavy chewing and swallowing sounds are layered under the narrator's final enthusiastic pitch and call to action. BGM fades smoothly.
